title: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair of Parentheses
goal: Reverse the contents of every matched parenthesis pair, starting from nested effects.
strategy: Precompute bracket partners, then walk the string with a direction. Jumping to a partner and reversing direction implements nested reversals in one traversal.
